sections.h2: Custom Signs for New York City Businesses
sections.html:
Vision Graphics designs, builds, and installs custom signs in NYC for storefronts, offices, lobbies, and multi-tenant buildings.

One team manages your project from the first photo to the final install, including permit paperwork and building coordination.

Behind that team is 60 years of Vision Graphics experience, and we serve brands from Salt Lake City, Las Vegas, and Michigan.

A single sign gets the same care as a multi-location rollout.

sections.h2: Exterior Signs for NYC Storefronts and Buildings
sections.intro_html:
Your exterior sign is the first thing customers see. We build business signs NYC owners can count on, from street-level storefronts to full building frontages.

We size each one to your facade, check it against city rules, and build it for New York weather. See all exterior signs.

items.title: Storefront Signs
items.html:
Signs that get noticed at street level. Fascia panels, lightboxes, and cabinet signs are sized for your frontage, the kind of New York store signs that read from across the street.

We check size and illumination rules for your zoning district before the design is final. Learn more about storefront signs.

items.title: Channel Letters
items.html:
Lit letters that read from across the avenue. Each letter uses LED lighting for night visibility.

We coordinate the electrical permit and a licensed electrician for the final connection. Learn more about channel letter signs.

items.title: Dimensional Letters
items.html: Raised letters with visible depth. Cut from metal or acrylic and mounted flush or on standoffs, with clean shadow lines for facades, entrances, and lobbies. Learn more about dimensional letter signs.

items.title: Building Signs
items.html: Identification for the whole building. Building signs carry tenant names, address numbers, and wall-mounted marks, and we coordinate landlord approvals alongside the design.

items.title: Blade Signs
items.html: Projecting signs that catch walkers from both directions. Blade signs hang over the sidewalk, so check projection and size rules for your building before finalizing the design.

items.title: Window Graphics
items.html: Window graphics that work from the sidewalk. Sign printing NYC storefronts need, from door lettering and privacy bands to full-window displays, on vinyl and frosted film that is easy to update when your offer changes.

sections.h2: Interior Signs for NYC Offices and Lobbies
sections.intro_html: Inside your space, signs set the tone for clients and staff. Our NYC signage range covers offices, lobbies, and shared floors, with custom signage NYC businesses can match across every room. See all interior signs.

items.title: Lobby and Reception Signs
items.html: The first brand moment inside the door. Logo walls and reception signs come in metal, acrylic, or wood, sized to the wall and the room. Learn more about lobby signs.

items.title: Office Signs
items.html: Names, suites, and brand walls on every floor. Suite signs, conference room plates, and logo walls match across the whole office. Learn more about office signs.

items.title: ADA Signs
items.html: Room signs made to accessibility standards. Tactile and Braille signs cover rooms, restrooms, and stairs. Learn more about ADA signs.

items.title: Directional Signs
items.html: Help people find the right floor and room. Directional signs guide visitors through lobbies, corridors, and elevator banks.

items.title: Door Signs
items.html: Clear identification at every door. Door signs carry suite numbers, tenant names, and room labels in one consistent style across a building.

sections.h2: Sign Fabrication and Installation in NYC
sections.intro_html:
A sign company NYC property managers trust has to do three things well: build the sign, get it approved, and mount it safely.

Our sign fabrication NYC process puts one team in charge of all three, so you have one point of contact from first photo to final install.

items.title: Who Makes It
items.html: Built by our production team. We build your sign to the drawing you approve, and we check each piece before it ships. Specialty items can involve trusted partners, and we tell you before you approve the quote.

items.title: Who Installs It
items.html:
Licensed installers for New York City. The city requires a licensed sign hanger for most installations, and a licensed electrician makes the final connection on lit signs.

Learn how it works on our sign installation NYC page.

items.title: Permits and Building Approvals
items.html: We prepare the paperwork. DOB sign permits, landmark district review, and landlord approvals depend on your building and sign type, and we map them before you commit.

items.title: Insurance and Building Access
items.html: Certificates and after-hours work, handled. We provide a certificate of insurance on request, and schedule installs around freight elevator windows, evenings, and weekends.

items.title: Old Sign Removal
items.html: We take down what you are replacing. Sign removal is part of the install plan, and we scope any wall repair in your quote.

items.title: Restaurants

items.title: Retail

items.title: Offices and Properties

sections.intro_html: Four steps take your sign from a photo to a finished install, with one point of contact throughout.
steps: Send a photo or book a site survey: Share a photo of the spot, your timeline, and any building rules. For exterior and lit signs, we measure on site and check access and power.
Design and approvals: You receive a drawing to approve before anything is built. We prepare permit and landlord paperwork alongside it.
Fabrication: We build to the approved drawing and check each piece before it ships.
Installation: A licensed crew installs on your building's schedule, including evenings and weekends when needed. The old sign comes down during the same visit.

sections.h2: Common Questions About Custom Signs in NYC

items.q: How much do custom signs cost in NYC?
items.a_html: Most business signs cost between $300 and $20,000 installed. Window graphics sit at the low end, while illuminated channel letters and large building signs sit at the high end. NYC permits, access equipment, and landlord requirements can add cost. We itemize every quote from a photo or a site survey.

items.q: How long does a custom sign take?
items.a_html: Simple graphics take one to two weeks. Lobby and office signs usually take two to three weeks. Illuminated exterior signs take three to five weeks, plus permit review. Landmark districts and building approvals can add time, so we flag them at the start of your project.

items.q: Do I need a permit for a business sign in NYC?
items.a_html: Usually yes. New York City requires a permit for business signs over six square feet and for any illuminated sign. Attached signs can need an alteration permit, lit signs need an electrical permit, and landmark districts add review. Ask any sign company in New York you compare who files the paperwork. We prepare it and coordinate the licensed filer.
Our production team builds your sign to the drawing you approve, and we check each piece before it ships. Specialty items can involve trusted partners. We tell you before you approve the quote.

A licensed NYC sign hanger installs your sign, because the city requires one for most installations. A licensed electrician makes the final connection on lit signs. We tell you who will be on site before installation day.

items.q: Can you provide a certificate of insurance for our building?
items.a_html: Yes. We provide a certificate of insurance on request, and we can send it before work begins. Buildings set their own coverage wording, so send us your requirements early, and we will match them where we can.

items.q: Can you install after hours or on weekends?
items.a_html: Yes. We schedule installs around your building's rules, including evenings, weekends, and freight elevator windows. After-hours work can add labor charges, and we confirm that in your quote.

items.q: Can you remove our old sign?
items.a_html: Yes. We remove the old sign as part of the install plan. NYC requires a licensed sign hanger for removal, and landmark buildings can require review. Any wall repair is scoped in your quote.

items.q: Can you handle signs for several NYC locations?
items.a_html: Yes. We handle one address or many, with the same drawings, finishes, and schedule across every site. Tell us each building's address, and we confirm permits and installation for each one.

items.q: Do you serve all five boroughs?
items.a_html: Yes. We serve all five boroughs, and every building has its own rules and access needs. Tell us your address when you request a quote, and we plan permits, scheduling, and installation for your site.
